boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Davis
boards.description: Ten currently listed late-hour food destinations in Davis, with official hours checked on 2026-08-13.

cards.title: Taco Bell on G Street
cards.subtitle: 425 G Street, Davis
cards.notes: Use the G Street location when you need a listed late dining option downtown; check the official page before leaving for day-specific hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown counter-service stop with hours listed as late as 4 a.m. on Fridays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists the 425 G Street restaurant in Davis and Friday dine-in hours of 9:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in hours as late as 4:00 a.m. on Friday; verify the applicable day before going.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers — E St
cards.title: Raising Cane's on E Street
cards.subtitle: 207 E Street, Davis
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or an order ahead at this E Street restaurant; its official page posts the same late hours for dine-in and drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: Chicken-finger meals served until 3:00 or 3:30 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 207 E Street Davis restaurant as open until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:30 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in and drive-thru until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:30 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 337 G St
cards.title: Jack in the Box on G Street
cards.subtitle: 337 G Street, Davis
cards.notes: For a later G Street option, use the official location page to confirm whether you want lobby service or the drive-thru before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Davis location with lobby hours listed to 2 a.m. and drive-thru service later.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 337 G Street Davis lobby open until 2:00 a.m. and its drive-thru open as late as 3:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 337 G St, Davis
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby service until 2:00 a.m. daily and drive-thru service as late as 3:00 a.m. on several days.

cards.title: The Melt on Russell Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 865 Russell Blvd, Suite 110, Davis
cards.notes: Head to the Davis Collection location for a food-focused stop near campus; place an order through the restaurant’s page and confirm service details before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Russell Boulevard restaurant that says it stays open until 2 a.m. nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: The Melt’s Davis location page gives the address at 865 Russell Blvd and states it is open until 2:00 a.m. every night.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official location page states 10:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Woodstock's Pizza Davis
cards.subtitle: 238 G Street, Davis
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s contact page to plan a G Street pizza pickup or dine-in; late closing is listed only on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Pizza on G Street with midnight hours most nights and 2 a.m. hours Thursday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodstock’s Pizza Davis lists 238 G Street and hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Woodstock's Pizza Davis — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hours list closing at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: In-N-Out on Olive Drive
cards.subtitle: 1020 Olive Drive, Davis
cards.notes: Use the Olive Drive restaurant for a late meal with drive-thru and dine-in seating; review the listed day before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Davis burger restaurant with 1 a.m. closing most nights and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official Davis page lists 1020 Olive Drive and normal hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Na Ya Dessert Cafe
cards.subtitle: 620 4th Street, Davis
cards.notes: Plan a late dessert stop on 4th Street and confirm the day’s closing time; the business lists its longest Davis hours on Friday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Davis dessert cafe with midnight closing Friday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Na Ya Dessert Cafe lists its Davis address as 620 4th Street and Davis hours until midnight Friday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Na Ya Dessert Cafe — Davis Location
cards.access_notes: Official Davis hours list noon–11:00 p.m. Monday–Thursday and noon–midnight Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Nick the Greek on E Street
cards.subtitle: 206 E Street, Davis
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own Davis ordering page for a late Mediterranean-food pickup and double-check availability before you go.
cards.short_summary: An E Street counter-service restaurant whose ordering page lists service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Nick the Greek’s Davis ordering page lists 206 E Street, Davis and hours of 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. the following day.
cards.source_title: Nick the Greek — Davis Menu and Hours
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s branded ordering page lists 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. (next day).

cards.entity_name: Domino's Pizza — 4120 Chiles Rd Unit B
cards.title: Domino's on Chiles Road
cards.subtitle: 4120 Chiles Road, Unit B, Davis
cards.notes: For an east-Davis pizza order, use the official store page and its order flow; check the current closing time before committing to pickup or delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Chiles Road pizza location whose official store page lists midnight closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Davis store page identifies 4120 Chiles Rd Unit B and lists the store as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza — 4120 Chiles Rd Unit B, Davis
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists the location as open until 12:00 a.m.; confirm the current day’s operating status before ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Chiles Road
cards.subtitle: 4811 Chiles Road, Davis
cards.notes: Use this Chiles Road location for a later east-Davis drive-thru; the official page separates the drive-thru and dining-room closing times.
cards.short_summary: An east-Davis Taco Bell with drive-thru service listed until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official 4811 Chiles Road page lists drive-thru hours of 8:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily and dine-in hours until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 1:00 a.m. daily; dine-in is listed until 12:00 a.m.
